utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Kira, I’m still spreading the word fast for the repair drive, so if you can swing by even briefly—or point me to anyone handy with tools—that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I lock anything in, can you confirm the repair list and who besides Bo is actually bringing tools?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m still waiting on the final count, but last I heard they’re starting with the porch steps and fence, and I’m checking with Mina on timing and supplies. Besides Bo, I only know Uli may stop by for a bit, so if you know anyone handy, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I still haven’t heard the final count, Vik—last I heard they’re starting with the porch steps and fence, and Mina probably has the latest on timing and who’s coordinating.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll repeat that around: porch steps and fence first, and Mina probably has the latest on timing and who’s coordinating.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik—that’s all I’ve got right now, so send folks to Mina if they want the latest while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Rey, let’s keep it simple: I’m checking with Sam tonight, and by eight we’ll know if the porch steps are first and whether to set out extra lumber.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay. I’m mostly thinking about Sunday too—Rosa’s coordinating the repair drive, and they still need one more fix-it table helper by 9:30 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, that’s clear—once I hear back from Sam tonight, I’ll tell Rosa by eight whether I can cover that fix-it table slot at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we share anything, can we confirm with Sam that it’s still small home fixes, bike repairs, and basic electronics?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, let’s confirm that with Sam first—once we’ve got the exact list and timing, I can see what fits between school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that’s exactly what I wanted to check, so once Sam confirms the timing, can we also make sure the list is still small home fixes, bike repairs, and basic electronics?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard it second-hand from Sam, but I think they’re still collecting supplies this weekend—I’m waiting on Sam’s final word to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—just have Sam send me the time, what needs fixing, and who’s bringing tools once it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do—I’m only going off what Sam said too, so I’ll pass it along once they confirm the timing and details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane—I’ve heard they’re still collecting repair drive supplies this weekend, but I’m checking with Sam now to confirm the timing so nobody shows up at the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’m coming in a bit late, but last I heard the working plan was still this weekend, so checking with Sam on the timing sounds smart before we tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Exactly—that’s what I’m trying to pin down with Sam, and I’ll pass the timing along as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right—Gus has the drill, sawhorses, and his level, and I’m pretty sure he said he’ll be there by eight for setup.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but I still want Leo to lock in the two table helpers and check-in person tonight, and we should remind everyone else volunteers need to be there by 9:30 so setup doesn’t get messy.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, right, I’ll ping Leo about the two table helpers and the check-in person tonight, and remind everybody about 9:30 too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Leo, I’ve got Sam checking the folding tables and tool bins by the community center lot first, and I’m still waiting on Faye’s exact midday window to log her in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—Rosa still needs two fix-it table helpers and one check-in person, all there by 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’m noting Rosa needs two fix-it table helpers and one check-in person by 9:30, and I’ll keep that pinned with the community center lot setup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll stop by for a little while with my screwdriver, but I’d like to stay off to the side if that’s alright.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s totally fine, Uli—thanks for bringing the screwdriver. I’m checking the folding tables and tool bins first, so I’ll let you know if there’s a small job off to the side.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. Just point me to a quiet corner when you’re ready, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I was just saying the same—we really need a clear list, with extension cords, power strips, screwdrivers, and spare parts right at the top so folks don’t all bring the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Right, but who’s confirming that list with Sam, and are the porch steps definitely still first?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check with Sam and make sure the porch steps are still first, but yes, that’s been the priority so far.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, yeah—the repair drive; I think Mara’s still the one to check with about volunteers, and I’m pretty sure we still need help with bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it—I’m already set for check-in at 9:30 and I’ll track the tools and supplies people bring, but I’ll point anyone asking about extra volunteer spots over to Mara.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good—thanks, Cleo; that really helps, and yeah, sending them to Mara is probably the right call.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Morning, Mara—I’ve got the drill, sawhorses, and level lined up for eight, so we should be in good shape for setup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Morning, Gus—that’s a huge help, thank you. I’m just waiting on Faye to confirm her midday window, then I’ll pass it along so we can lock her in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect—once Faye confirms, send it my way, and I’ll be there with the drill, sawhorses, and level by eight.
